title: When the Inventory Wakes
author: Noor Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Underhill, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
